item.coloph: čoγtu lha bčanbo tngri toyin bodhi gerel-ün ǰarliq-iyar , enedkeg-ün ubadini yeke upasika kumar-a-kalasa kiged ayalgu orčiruluγči kelemürči sayin oyutu sakya loroi ayaq-γ-a tegimlig ber orčiγuluγad nayiraγulǰu orusiγulbai , degedü nom-un mergen čakravad-un qutuγ-tu činggi tayun qaγan-u ǰarliq-iyar , tegsi tabun uqaγan-dur mergen darqan blam-a kiged pandita qoyar blam-a-yi kereglen sitügsen-iyer , tal kelen-i medegči bsinba toyin orčiγuluγsan-iyar , delekei-yin eǰen qaγan qatun qamuγ ači-tan engke esen burqan-u qutuγ-i olqu bolumui .

čoγ-tu bančan tngri bodi gerel-ün ǰarliγ-iyar enedkeg-ün ubadini yeke ubasika kümar-a kalasa kiged ayalγu orčiγuluγči / kelemürči sayin oyutu sakya ayaγ-qa tegimlig orčiγuluγad orosiγulbai, degedü nom-un mergen čakirbad-un qutuγ-tu činggis / tayisu qaγan-u ǰarliγ-iyar, tegsi tabun uqaγan-dur mergen darqan lam-a <kiged baṇdiḍa qoyar lam-a>-yi gerelen (=?kereglen) sitügsen-iyer, tel kelen-i / üčüken medegči bsinba toyin orčiγuluγsan-iyar delekeiyin (!) eǰen qaγan qatun qamuγ eǰeten (=ačitan?) engke esen / burqan-u qutuγ-i olqu bolumui. manǰusiri-yin iǰaγur ḓandir-a-yi masi bisirel-iyer bayasulčan / sečen nangsu bilig-tü bayan čenggetei edeger bičigečin bičibei, manggalam, .

qutuγ-tu manǰusiri-yin iǰaγur ündüsün dandir-a tegüsbei. čoγ-tu bčan bu tngri ariγun tngri bodi gerel-ün ǰarliγ-iyar, enedkeg-ün ubadini yeke ubasika kümar-a kalasa kiged ayalγu orčiγuluγči kelemürči sayin oyutu sakya ayaγ-qa takimlig orčiγulu-γad orosiγulbai, manggalam . degedü nom-un mergen čakravad-un qutuγ-tu činggis tang dayisun qaγan-u ǰarliγ-iyar, tegsi tabun uqaγan-tur mergen, darqan blam-a kiged, baṇdida qoyar blam-a-yi gerlen sitügsen-iyer, tel kelen-i üčüken medegči bsinba toyin orčiγuluγsan-iyar, delekei-yin eǰen qaγan qatun qamuγ ači-tan engke esen burqan-u qutuγ-i olqu bolumui. manǰusiri -yin iǰaγur dandir-a-yi, masi bisirel-iyer bayasulčan seče nangso, biligtü bayan činggitei edeger bičigečin bičibei . , . manggalam, .
